e.title: EIOPA 登记册群与 IDD 分销商处罚数据：超国家层的保险中介登记与执法统计
e.title_en: EIOPA’s registers and its IDD distributor-sanctions data: supranational registration and enforcement statistics for insurance intermediaries
e.title_hk: EIOPA 登記冊群與 IDD 分銷商處罰數據：超國家層的保險中介登記與執法統計
e.summary: 欧盟保险与职业养老金监管局：集中托管保险中介、保险机构、IORP、审慎条款、PEPP 中央登记册与各国法律登记册，并按 IDD 汇总各国对保险分销商的处罚数据（2018–2024，2024 年 1,656 起、撤销注册占 51%），附五年年报与汇总 XLSX
e.summary_en: The EU insurance and occupational pensions authority: it hosts central registers for insurance intermediaries, insurance undertakings, IORPs, prudential provisions, a PEPP central register and a register of national laws, and aggregates EEA sanctions on insurance distributors under the IDD (2018–2024; 1,656 sanctions in 2024, with registration withdrawals at 51%), with five annual reports and an aggregated XLSX
e.summary_hk: 歐盟保險與職業養老金監管局：集中託管保險中介、保險機構、IORP、審慎條款、PEPP 中央登記冊與各國法律登記冊，並按 IDD 匯總各國對保險分銷商的處罰數據（2018–2024，2024 年 1,656 起、撤銷註冊佔 51%），附五年年報與匯總 XLSX
e.body:
**EIOPA（European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority，欧洲保险与职业养老金监管局）** 是**欧盟层面的保险与职业养老金监管机构**。本条目**不是**重复池内已有的 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（那是**行业统计**），而是补**「超国家层的中介登记 + 分销商执法数据」**——**实测「中介登记/中介监管」这一形态此前为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Registers, lists and databases（登记册、清单与数据库）」页 `/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en` 实测 97.1KB**，正文实测写明 **「EIOPA hosts a series of repositories of data, lists and databases of relevance for the insurance and occupational pensions sectors」**，并在 **REGISTERS** 分组下实测列出：**Insurance intermediaries（保险中介）**、**Insurance undertakings（保险机构）**、**Institutions for Occupational Retirement Provision IORPs（职业退休机构）**、**Prudential Provisions**、**PEPP central register（泛欧个人养老金产品中央登记册）**、**Register of national laws, regulations…（各国法律登记册）**。⭐ **「Data on sanctions imposed on insurance distributors（对保险分销商处罚的数据）」页 `/tools-and-data/data-sanctions-imposed-insurance-distributors_en` 实测 132.6KB**，正文实测写明机制：**「Under the Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD), national supervisors across the European Economic Area (EEA) must notify EIOPA of any sanctions they impose on insurance distributors when these companies or individuals breach relevant IDD provisions」**——**依《保险分销指令》IDD，EEA 各国监管者必须把对保险分销商施加的处罚通报 EIOPA**；数据范围实测为 **「data between 2018 and 2024, with a focus on the most recent data reported to EIOPA for 2024」**，⭐ **实测写明「1,656 sanctions imposed in 2024」**（**2024 年 1,656 起**），并写明处罚数在 2021 年达到峰值；⭐ 实测写明 **「The most commonly used sanction has been the withdrawal of the registration (i.e. the license) of the company. In 2024, withdrawals of registration represented 51% of all sancti[ons]」**（**最常用处罚是撤销公司注册即牌照，2024 年占总数的 51%**）；⭐ **同一页 EIOPA 主动声明数据局限**：**「given that sanctions are generally targeted at individual companies or individuals, the data provides only a partial perspective of conduct or supervisory issues. Hence, full conclusions regarding the effectiveness of the supervision of the rules by national authorities, cannot be drawn based only on the number of sanctions」**。**可下载文件实测**：五年期年报（首份、2020、2021、第四份 2022、**第五份 2023（EIOPA-BOS-25-013）**）与 **`MSSubmissionsAggregatedReports.xlsx`（成员国报送汇总表，机器可读）**。另实测 **「Supervisory reporting - DPM and XBRL」页 `/tools-and-data/supervisory-reporting-dpm-and-xbrl_en` 153.3KB**（**监管报送的数据点模型与 XBRL 分类标准**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「中介是谁、是否持牌」这一层**——池内中介侧**已有大量中介「公司」条目**（[[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[miller-insurance]]、[[pacific-prime]]、[[insurance-broker]] 等），**但「这些中介由谁登记、在哪里可查」此前为 0**；**EIOPA 的登记册群把中介、保险机构、IORP、PEPP 的登记集中在一个入口**，**对做跨境合规与中介尽调的学生是直接可用的**。**② ⭐ 「IDD 分销商处罚数据」是一个罕见的公开执法数据集**——**它把「分销环节的不当行为」量化到可比较的层面**（年份、处罚类型、撤销注册占比），**且是超国家合并口径**；这与池内 [[fos-uk]]（英国争议裁决）、[[fscs-uk]]、[[nolhga]]、[[assuris]]（保障机制）**属不同的消费者保护环节**——**那一组是「事后救济」，这一条是「事前监管 + 事后处罚」**。**③ ⭐ EIOPA 自己写明「不能只凭处罚数量判断监管有效性」**——**这是一个很好的方法论警示**：池内 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] 聚合监管态势，**而本条给出的是「监管者对自己数据局限的官方说明」**，**引用处罚数据时应同时引用这一句**。**④ 「PEPP 中央登记册」与「各国法律登记册」是两种少见的登记形态**——**一个是跨境个人养老金产品的中央登记，一个是把各国法律集中登记**（后者可与 [[aae]] 的欧洲精算实务准则、[[insurance-europe]] 的行业口径并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**两个页面的存在、标题、体量、登记册清单、IDD 通报机制表述、2024 年 1,656 起与撤销注册 51% 的数字、EIOPA 自述局限、可下载文件名与五年年报标题**，**但未打开任何年报正文、未下载 XLSX、未打开任何登记册本身**，因此**不能转述处罚的分国分布、具体机构名称、处罚金额或登记册内容**；**② ⚠️ 专用登记册域名 `register.eiopa.europa.eu` 本次实测返回 HTTP 403（Forbidden）——即「登记册应用本体」我未能访问**，**故本词条只主张「EIOPA 托管这些登记册」这一事实（来自其页面正文），不描述任何登记册的界面、检索方式或数据字段**；**③ 1,656 与 51% 两个数字来自页面正文实测**，**其统计口径（是否含个人、是否含各国全部处罚）本次未逐项核实**；**④ 「中介登记/中介监管」形态为 0 是关键词测量的结论**（**关键词法为启发式，已在轮次日志中记录其局限**）；**⑤ 本次未核实 DPM/XBRL 页的具体分类标准版本与适用范围**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** EIOPA 提供精算工具或公司级财务数据。**核实说明**：`/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en`（97.1KB）、`/tools-and-data/data-sanctions-imposed-insurance-distributors_en`（132.6KB）、`/tools-and-data/supervisory-reporting-dpm-and-xbrl_en`（153.3KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取正文；`register.eiopa.europa.eu` 实测 **403**（未访问）；**未打开年报、未下载 XLSX、未打开登记册**。
e.body_en:
**EIOPA (the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority)** is **the EU-level supervisor for insurance and occupational pensions**. This entry does **not** duplicate the corpus’s existing [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] (which covers **industry statistics**); it adds the **"supranational intermediary registration plus distributor enforcement data"** layer — **the "intermediary register / intermediary regulation" form measured zero before this round**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Registers, lists and databases" page `/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en` measures 97.1KB**, stating verbatim that **"EIOPA hosts a series of repositories of data, lists and databases of relevance for the insurance and occupational pensions sectors"**, and listing under a **REGISTERS** grouping: **Insurance intermediaries**, **Insurance undertakings**, **Institutions for Occupational Retirement Provision (IORPs)**, **Prudential Provisions**, a **PEPP central register** and a **Register of national laws, regulations**. ⭐ The **"Data on sanctions imposed on insurance distributors" page measures 132.6KB**, stating the mechanism verbatim: **"Under the Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD), national supervisors across the European Economic Area (EEA) must notify EIOPA of any sanctions they impose on insurance distributors when these companies or individuals breach relevant IDD provisions"**; the measured data range is **"data between 2018 and 2024, with a focus on the most recent data reported to EIOPA for 2024"**, with the measured statement **"1,656 sanctions imposed in 2024"**, the number having peaked in 2021; ⭐ it states verbatim that **"The most commonly used sanction has been the withdrawal of the registration (i.e. the license) of the company. In 2024, withdrawals of registration represented 51% of all sancti[ons]"**; ⭐ **EIOPA itself states the data’s limitation on the same page**: **"given that sanctions are generally targeted at individual companies or individuals, the data provides only a partial perspective of conduct or supervisory issues. Hence, full conclusions regarding the effectiveness of the supervision of the rules by national authorities, cannot be drawn based only on the number of sanctions"**. **Measured downloadable files** include five annual reports (the first, 2020, 2021, the fourth for 2022 and the **fifth for 2023, EIOPA-BOS-25-013**) and **`MSSubmissionsAggregatedReports.xlsx`** (a machine-readable aggregated member-state submission file). Also measured: the **"Supervisory reporting - DPM and XBRL" page (153.3KB)**, covering the supervisory-reporting **data point model and XBRL taxonomy**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "who the intermediaries are and whether they are licensed" layer** — the corpus **already holds many intermediary *firms*** ([[marsh]], [[howden]], [[miller-insurance]], [[pacific-prime]], [[insurance-broker]] and others), **but "who registers them and where they can be checked" was at zero**; **EIOPA’s register group brings intermediaries, undertakings, IORPs and PEPP registration into a single entry point**, **directly usable for cross-border compliance and intermediary due diligence**. **② ⭐ The IDD distributor-sanctions data is a rare public enforcement dataset** — **it quantifies misconduct in the distribution chain at a comparable level** (year, sanction type, share of registration withdrawals) **on a supranational consolidated basis**; this sits at a **different point in consumer protection** from [[fos-uk]] (UK dispute decisions), [[fscs-uk]], [[nolhga]] and [[assuris]] (protection mechanisms) — **that group is ex-post redress; this is ex-ante supervision plus ex-post penalties**. **③ ⭐ EIOPA states that sanction counts alone cannot establish supervisory effectiveness** — **a valuable methodological caution**: the corpus’s [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] and [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] aggregate regulatory postures, **whereas this entry supplies the regulator’s own official statement of its data’s limits**, **and that sentence should be cited alongside any use of the sanction figures**. **④ The "PEPP central register" and the "register of national laws" are two uncommon register forms** — **one is a central register for a cross-border personal pension product, the other registers national laws in one place** (the latter readable with [[aae]] on European actuarial practice standards and [[insurance-europe]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **two pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the register list, the IDD notification mechanism, the 2024 figures of 1,656 sanctions and 51% registration withdrawals, EIOPA’s own limitation statement, downloadable file names and five annual report titles**, **but opened no annual report body, downloaded no XLSX and opened none of the registers themselves**, so **the country breakdown, named firms, penalty amounts and register contents cannot be restated**; **② ⚠️ the dedicated register domain `register.eiopa.europa.eu` returned HTTP 403 (Forbidden) in this check — I could not access the register application itself**, **so this entry asserts only that EIOPA hosts these registers (from its own page text) and describes no register interface, search method or data field**; **③ the figures 1,656 and 51% come from measured page text**, and **their statistical basis (whether individuals are included, whether all national sanctions are covered) was not verified item by item**; **④ the zero count for the "intermediary register / regulation" form is a keyword-measurement result** (**the method is heuristic and its limitations are recorded in the round log**); **⑤ the DPM/XBRL page’s taxonomy version and scope were not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim EIOPA provides actuarial tools or firm-level financial data**. **Verification note**: `/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en` (97.1KB), `/tools-and-data/data-sanctions-imposed-insurance-distributors_en` (132.6KB) and `/tools-and-data/supervisory-reporting-dpm-and-xbrl_en` (153.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with body text read verbatim; `register.eiopa.europa.eu` measured **403** (not accessed); **no annual report, XLSX or register was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**EIOPA（European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority，歐洲保險與職業養老金監管局）** 是**歐盟層面的保險與職業養老金監管機構**。本條目**不是**重複池內已有的 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（那是**行業統計**），而是補**「超國家層的中介登記 + 分銷商執法數據」**——**實測「中介登記／中介監管」這一形態此前為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Registers, lists and databases」頁 97.1KB**，正文寫明 **「EIOPA hosts a series of repositories of data, lists and databases of relevance for the insurance and occupational pensions sectors」**，並在 **REGISTERS** 分組下實測列出：**Insurance intermediaries**、**Insurance undertakings**、**IORPs**、**Prudential Provisions**、**PEPP central register**、**Register of national laws**。⭐ **「Data on sanctions imposed on insurance distributors」頁 132.6KB**，正文寫明 **「Under the Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD), national supervisors across the European Economic Area (EEA) must notify EIOPA of any sanctions they impose on insurance distributors…」**；數據範圍 **2018–2024**；⭐ 實測寫明 **「1,656 sanctions imposed in 2024」**，並寫明峰值在 2021 年；⭐ **「The most commonly used sanction has been the withdrawal of the registration (i.e. the license) of the company. In 2024, withdrawals of registration represented 51% of all sancti[ons]」**；⭐ **同頁 EIOPA 主動聲明局限**：**「…the data provides only a partial perspective of conduct or supervisory issues. Hence, full conclusions regarding the effectiveness of the supervision of the rules by national authorities, cannot be drawn based only on the number of sanctions」**。**可下載檔案實測**：五期年報（首份、2020、2021、第四份 2022、**第五份 2023**）與 **`MSSubmissionsAggregatedReports.xlsx`**。另實測 **「Supervisory reporting - DPM and XBRL」頁 153.3KB**（**監管報送的數據點模型與 XBRL 分類標準**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「中介是誰、是否持牌」這一層**——池內中介側**已有大量中介「公司」條目**（[[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[miller-insurance]]、[[pacific-prime]]、[[insurance-broker]] 等），**但「這些中介由誰登記、在哪裡可查」此前為 0**。**② ⭐ 「IDD 分銷商處罰數據」是罕見的公開執法數據集**——**把分銷環節的不當行為量化到可比較層面**，**且是超國家合併口徑**；與池內 [[fos-uk]]、[[fscs-uk]]、[[nolhga]]、[[assuris]] **屬不同環節**——**那一組是「事後救濟」，這一條是「事前監管 + 事後處罰」**。**③ ⭐ EIOPA 自己寫明「不能只憑處罰數量判斷監管有效性」**——**引用處罰數據時應同時引用這一句**。**④ 「PEPP 中央登記冊」與「各國法律登記冊」是兩種少見的登記形態**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**兩頁的存在、標題、體量、登記冊清單、IDD 通報機制、2024 年 1,656 起與撤銷註冊 51%、EIOPA 自述局限、可下載檔名與年報標題**，**但未打開任何年報正文、未下載 XLSX、未打開任何登記冊本身**，故**不能轉述分國分佈、機構名稱、處罰金額或登記冊內容**；**② ⚠️ 專用登記冊域名 `register.eiopa.europa.eu` 本次實測返回 HTTP 403（Forbidden），即「登記冊應用本體」未能訪問**，**故本詞條只主張「EIOPA 託管這些登記冊」這一事實，不描述任何登記冊的界面、檢索方式或數據欄位**；**③ 1,656 與 51% 來自頁面正文實測**，**其統計口徑未逐項核實**；**④ 「中介登記」形態為 0 屬關鍵詞測量結論**（**方法為啟發式，局限已記錄於輪次日誌**）；**⑤ DPM/XBRL 的分類標準版本與適用範圍未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** EIOPA 提供精算工具或公司級財務數據**。**核實說明**：三頁均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取正文；`register.eiopa.europa.eu` 實測 **403**（未訪問）；**未打開年報、未下載 XLSX、未打開登記冊**。
